thread:
incident-bot: Incident created: HIGH_LATENCY_CHAT_P99 for route /v1/chat/completions (model_group:mistral-3b). Paging oncall.
Maya Ramos: paging in — seeing p99 spike ~3.2s on prod for chat completions across eu-west1. Appears correlated with recent canary of kernel v2.1. cc @Sahil @Jordan
platform-oncall-bot: @here PagerDuty alarm triggered (PD-4521). Current alerts: p95=450ms, p99=3.2s, error rate small (<0.1%).
Sahil Kapoor: I'm on it. grabbing metrics now. any customer-facing impact?
Maya Ramos: no customer pages yet but a few calls timed out in our internal test harness. We had a small SLO burn on a partner route.
Jordan Park: I see request tail latency map — spike hits only mistral-3b routes and some tiebreaker routes routed to eu-west1-gpu-02. Looks like qkv-cache eviction is happening after ~10s windows.
Liz Huang: Can you paste the grafana query? I'll snapshot and create a temporary dashboard.
Sahil Kapoor: Grafana panel (rough):
```
avg_over_time(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(redwood_runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/chat/completions", model_group="mistral-3b"}[5m])))[5m])
```
Sahil Kapoor: here's the alert rule that's firing (current):
```
- name: chat-completions-p99-prod
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/v1/chat.*", env="prod"}[5m]))) > 1.5
  for: 5m
  labels: {severity: page}
```
Maya Ramos: we just deployed kernel v2.1 canary to 10% earlier. hypothesis: kernel v2.1 interacts poorly with our KV cache compaction on long conversations => longer tail.
Jordan Park: Mitigation plan: 1) scale down canary to 0% 2) route mistral-3b to fallback model variant (mistral-3b-ht) for requests with >512 tokens 3) temporarily raise p99 alert to reduce noise while we stabilize.
Liz Huang: Agreed. I'll change routing first (low-risk) and keep canary pinned.
platform-oncall-bot: Starting routing rollback: set canary weight -> 0
platform-oncall-bot: Routing change applied (cfg id r-8912). Waiting for convergence.
Sahil Kapoor: Routing rollback confirmed, weight 0. Observed immediate reduction on eu-west1-gpu-02 traffic for mistral-3b.
Maya Ramos: Initiating fallback routing rule for long sequences:
```
route_rule:
  match: request.tokens > 512 and model_group == "mistral-3b"
  action: route_to: "mistral-3b-ht"
```
Maya Ramos: Fallback applied. Early metrics: p99 dropped from 3.2s -> 1.1s on affected routes.
Jordan Park: Good. Now alert tuning: proposal to avoid paging for transient noisy regressions: change chat-completions-p99-prod rule: severity -> ticket for 15m, page if >2.0s for 15m sustained. Also add per-model label so spurious pages for one model don't wake whole oncall.
Sahil Kapoor: I'll push a quick alert patch (short-term). Longer term we should create a per-route noise gate using busy-window and p99-derivative.
Liz Huang: Patch preview:
```
- name: chat-completions-p99-prod-per-model
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (model_group, le) (rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/v1/chat.*", env="prod"}[5m]))) > 2.0
  for: 15m
  labels: {severity: ticket}
```
Liz Huang: and keep a separate high-severity rule for cross-model regressions:
```
- name: chat-completions-p99-prod-global
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/v1/chat.*", env="prod"}[5m]))) > 4.0
  for: 5m
  labels: {severity: page}
```
Sahil Kapoor: pushed alert draft to repo, starting CI. tag @oncall for approval.
Maya Ramos: CI green. Merging and applying. This will stop immediate pages for 1-off model regressions and only page on cluster-wide meltdowns.
platform-oncall-bot: Alert rules updated (cfg id a-2234). Note: index cards created for per-model dashboards.
Jordan Park: Follow-ups captured: 1) rollback kernel v2.1 canary and run KV cache instrumentation on canary 2) add a per-route p99 dashboard with model_group label 3) create a runbook for fallback routing 4) update oncall runbook threshold guidance.
Maya Ramos: I'll own (1) and (4). Jordan owns (2). Liz will document (3) and add the Grafana panels. Sahil will lead a post-deploy QA run once kernel fix is in.
Liz Huang: Created temporary dashboard: "chat-p99-by-model" with panels for p95/p99 and token-length buckets. Saved to folder eng-platform/incidents. Link: https://grafana/redwood/d/abcd1234/chat-p99-by-model
Maya Ramos: Handoff: I'm pausing investigations for now — routing rollback + fallback are live and stable for last 30m. Will pass to Jordan for full RCA.
Jordan Park: Taking over. I'll schedule a postmortem and add the new alert snippets to the alerting playbook. Also will set a guardrail in infra deploy pipeline to block kernel v2.1 rollout until KV cache tests pass.
platform-oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: from Maya Ramos to Jordan Park at 1932109268. Reminder: update PD escalation policy if we want to change page windows.
Maya Ramos: closing the pager. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Liz Huang: FYI: partner alpha reported slight lag earlier; we've contacted them and offered to reroute until full RCA.
Sahil Kapoor: TL;DR: canary kernel caused KV compaction edge-case => p99 spike on long chat convos on mistral-3b. Mitigated by rollback + long-convo fallback. Alerting updated to be per-model and higher page threshold.
Jordan Park: I'll open the postmortem thread in incidents and link this thread. Expected deliverable: RCA + tests to catch kv compaction regressions before canary. ETA 72 hours.
